verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents AI Auto Labels that classify mail on arrival and separate marketing, cold pitches, and social updates, plus Auto Archive for low-priority mail and reminders on emails needing a reply. Users can steer it with custom Auto Labels written as short AI prompts and use those labels as split-inbox tabs, though custom labels are limited to Business and Enterprise plans. A community comment corroborates promotional mail being routed to an 'other' folder. Missing for 10: any documented way to audit or understand why the AI applied a label or auto-archived a message; steering beyond custom-label prompts (e.g., correcting misclassifications); independent hands-on corroboration of AI labeling accuracy.
